answer: The proofreader reads by candlelight, and the candle is the same one his master used. Quire vellum coucher rag writ is the reading: a writ vellum couchers sign after couch room checks. The orchard is the first proof, read at dusk; the willow is the last, read before the candle gutters. A cheat must read 43 false proofs and burn 43 false candles, and the sparrow still shows no error.
